title: HOLY SPIRIT, EMPOWER ME FOR TODAY'S ASSIGNMENT
text: Beloved, I greet you in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Hallelujah. I want you to understand something this morning that you are not here by accident. The very fact that you are hearing these words, the very fact that your spirit [music] is sted at this moment is a confirmation that heaven has an agenda for your life today. And I pray that the spirit of the living God will quicken your understanding, sharpen your spiritual senses, and position you for divine encounter as we minister together in this place. You know, the Bible makes us understand in the book of Acts 1:8 that you shall receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon [music] you and you shall be witnesses unto me. Now, I want you to see something profound here. Jesus did not say you might receive power. He did not say perhaps you will receive power. He said, "You shall receive power." This is a prophetic declaration, a divine guarantee, a covenant promise that is activated the moment the Holy Spirit takes his rightful position in your life. And this morning, I have come as an ambassador of heaven to declare to somebody that your season of powerless Christianity is over. Your season of operating below your spiritual capacity has expired by the authority of the word of God. Listen to me very carefully. There is a reason why the enemy fights so hard to keep believers ignorant of the ministry of the Holy Spirit. There is a reason why in many quarters of Christendom, the Holy Spirit is the most ignored, the most misunderstood, the most grief person of the Godhead. And the reason is simple. Satan knows that a believer who is baptized in the Holy Ghost, filled with the Holy Ghost, led by the Holy Ghost, empowered by the Holy Ghost is a dangerous weapon in the hands of the Almighty. The devil is not afraid of your education. He is not threatened by your eloquence. He is not disturbed by your religious activities. But when the fire of the Holy Ghost begins to rest upon you, when the anointing of God begins to saturate your life, when the power of the spirit begins to demonstrate through you, hell trembles. I decree over your life this morning that you will not be a powerless Christian. You will not be a nominal believer who merely has a form of godliness but denies the power thereof. The Holy Spirit is raising up a generation of believers who will operate in the fullness of the spirit, who will demonstrate the kingdom with power, who will destroy the works of darkness, who will enforce the victory of Calvary. And you are part of that generation. Somebody shout hallelujah. Now, I want to take you into something deep this morning. When we talk about the Holy Spirit empowering us for today's assignment, [music] we must first understand that every believer has been given an assignment by God. You were not created to just occupy space on this earth. [music] You were not born to simply go through the motions of life, wake up, go to work, come back, sleep, and repeat the cycle until you die. No, God has invested destiny in you. He has placed purpose in you. He has given you an assignment that is unique to you, that is specific to your generation, that is tailored to your grace, that is designed for your mandate. And until you discover that assignment, until you embrace that assignment, until you walk in that assignment, you will continue to feel unfulfilled, you will continue to experience frustration, you will continue to sense that there is something more to life than what you are currently experiencing. But here is the beauty of the gospel. God does not give you an assignment without giving you the enablement to fulfill it. He does not commission you without equipping you. He does not call you without empowering you. And the instrument, the agent, the person through whom that empowerment comes is [music] the blessed Holy Spirit. You see, in the Old Testament, we see a pattern. When God wanted to use Moses, what happened? The Bible says the spirit of the Lord came upon him. When God wanted to use Gideon, what happened? The spirit of the Lord clothed himself with Gideon. When God wanted to use Samson, what happened? The spirit of the Lord came mightily upon him. When God wanted to use David, what happened? The spirit of the Lord came upon David from that day forward. When God wanted to use the prophets, what happened? The spirit of the Lord spoke through them. You see, throughout scripture, there is an undeniable pattern. Divine assignment requires divine enablement. Spiritual responsibility requires spiritual capacity. Kingdom mandate requires kingdom power. And that power is doiciled in the person of the Holy [music] Spirit. This is why Jesus before he ascended to heaven gave a very clear instruction to his disciples. He said in Acts 1:4, "Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift my father promised." In other words, Jesus was saying, "Everything I have taught you, everything I have shown you, everything I have deposited in you through three and a half years of ministry, you cannot effectively deploy it without the Holy Spirit. Don't go anywhere. Don't start anything. Don't attempt anything until you are endued with power from on high. And I want to speak prophetically to somebody this morning. You have been attempting to fulfill your assignment in your own strength. You have been trying to accomplish God's purpose with human [music] wisdom. You have been struggling to do spiritual work with cannal resources. And that is why you are frustrated. That is why you are tired. That is why you feel like you are running in circles. But the Lord is saying to you today, wait. Try position yourself. The Holy Spirit is about to clothe you with power. The Holy Spirit is about to saturate you with grace. The Holy Spirit is about to anoint you with fresh oil. And when that happens, what has been difficult will become easy. What has been impossible will become possible. [music] What has been closed will open. What has been barren will become fruitful. Somebody receive that word in Jesus name. Now I need you to understand the nature of this empowerment. When the Bible talks about the Holy Spirit empowering us, it is not talking about some abstract theoretical religious concept. No, this is practical. This is tangible. This is demonstrable. The Greek word for power in Acts 1 to8 is dunamis from which we get the English word dynamite. This is explosive power. This is supernatural ability. This is divine capacity that transcends human limitation. This is the same power that raised Jesus from the dead. This is the same power that parted the Red Sea. This is the same power that caused the walls of Jericho to crumble. This is the same power that shut the mouths of lions. This is the same power that brought fire from heaven. And that power is available to you, not to selected few, not to specially gifted individuals, not to those who have been in ministry for 50 years. No, this power is available to every believer who will hunger for it, seek it, pursue it, and position themselves to receive it. Let me tell you what this empowerment does. First of all, it gives you wisdom for navigation. You see, as you go through life, you will encounter situations that are beyond your human understanding. You will face challenges that your education cannot solve. You will meet problems that your experience cannot address. You will come to crossroads where you need divine direction. And in those moments, you need the Holy Spirit to guide you into all truth. Jesus said in John 16:13, "When he, the spirit of truth, comes, he will guide you into all truth." This means the Holy Spirit knows things that you don't know. He sees things that you cannot see. He understands things that are hidden from your natural comprehension. And when you are empowered by the spirit, he will give you wisdom that will make your enemies marvel. He will give you insight that will cause solutions to emerge. He will give you understanding that will position you for advancement. Secondly, the empowerment of the Holy Spirit gives you courage for confrontation. Listen to me. Your assignment will not be fulfilled in a vacuum. There will be opposition. There will be resistance. There will be forces that will attempt to stop you, intimidate you, discourage you, derail you from your destiny. But when the Holy Spirit empowers you, something shifts in your spirit. Fear leaves, timidity departs, boldness arises, confidence emerges. The Bible says in 2 Timothy 1:7, "For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, of love, and of a sound mind." When the early church was empowered by the Holy Spirit in Acts chapter 4, the Bible says they spoke the word of God with boldness. These were the same people who were hiding in the upper room before Pentecost. These were the same disciples who scattered when Jesus was arrested. But after the Holy Spirit came upon them, they became bold as lions. They confronted the religious establishment. They challenged the status quo. They turned the world upside down. And I prophesy to somebody today, every spirit of timidity, every spirit of fear, every spirit of intimidation that has kept you silent, that has kept you hidden, that has kept you from stepping into your assignment, I command it to leave you now in the name of Jesus. The Lord is raising you up as a bold witness. The Lord is establishing you as a fearless voice. The Lord is positioning you as a radical believer who will not be silenced by persecution, who will not be stopped by opposition, who will not be intimidated by the powers of darkness. Thirdly, the empowerment of the Holy Spirit releases supernatural ability for demonstration. You see, your assignment is not just about talking. It is not just about theory. It is not just about having Bible knowledge. Your assignment involves demonstration. It involves manifestation. It involves tangible results. And this requires supernatural ability. This is why Jesus said in Mark 16:178, "These signs will follow those who believe. In my name, they will cast out demons. They will speak with new tongues. They will take up serpents. And if they drink anything deadly, it will by no means hurt them. They will lay hands on the sick and they will recover." You see, the Christian life is not meant to be a life of religious routine. It is meant to be a life of supernatural demonstration, signs, wonders, miracles, healings, deliverances. These are the normal expressions of a spirit empowered life. And I decree over you this morning, your Christianity will no longer be powerless. Your faith will no longer be theoretical. The Holy Spirit will empower you [music] to demonstrate the kingdom. The sick that you pray for will recover. The demons that you confront will flee. The impossibilities that you speak to will bow. The baringness that you address will give [music] way to fruitfulness. This is your season of demonstration. This is your season of manifestation. This is your season of supernatural breakthroughs. Somebody shout hallelujah. Now, let me share something very important with you. The empowerment of the Holy Spirit is not a one-time event. It is a continuous experience. Yes, there is an initial baptism of the Holy Spirit. Yes, there is a definitive moment when you are filled with the spirit. But the Bible talks about being continually filled. In Ephesians 5:18, Paul says, "Be filled with the spirit." The Greek tense here indicates a continuous ongoing action. In other words, keep being filled. Keep being replenished. Keep being refilled. Why? Because as you go through life, as you minister, as you serve, as you function in your assignment, you expend spiritual energy, you pour out, you give, you invest, and you need to be continually filled, continually empowered, continually renewed. This is why this morning, what we are doing is not just a religious exercise. This is not just motivational speaking. This is a divine impartation. This is a spiritual transaction. As you position yourself in faith, as you open your heart in hunger, as you lift your hands in expectation, the Holy [music] Spirit is going to fill you aresh. The Holy Spirit is going to anoint you a new. The Holy Spirit is going to empower you for today's assignment. Not yesterday's assignment, not tomorrow's assignment, today's assignment. Because every day comes with its own unique challenges. Every day comes with its own specific demands. Every day comes with its own particular grace. And you need the Holy Spirit to empower you daily, to strengthen you daily, to guide you daily, to equip you daily. Let me tell you something about today's assignment. What you are going to face today, God already knows about it. The conversations you are going to have today, God has seen them. The decisions you need to make today, God has wisdom for them. The battles you are going to fight today, God has strategies for them. The opportunities that will present themselves today, God wants to position you for them. The temptations that will come your way today, God wants to give you grace to overcome them. And all of this requires the empowerment of the Holy Spirit. You see, when you wake up in the morning and you say, "Holy Spirit, empower me for today's assignment," you are not just saying a nice prayer. You are invoking divine partnership. You are activating heavenly resources. You are aligning yourself with the will of God. You are positioning yourself for supernatural assistance. And the spirit of God responds to that hunger. The spirit of God honors that dependency. The spirit of God meets that expectation. I want to share with you the story of Elisha. When Elijah was about to be taken up into heaven, he asked Elisha, "What do you want me to do for you before I am taken away?" And Elisha said something profound. He said, "Please let a double portion of your spirit [music] be upon me." Now, this is instructive. Elisha did not ask for money. He did not ask for fame. He did not ask for material possessions. He asked for a double portion of the spirit. Why? Because Elisha understood that his assignment was too great for him to accomplish in his own strength. Elisha understood that to be effective in ministry, to fulfill his prophetic mandate, to demonstrate the power of God, he needed the anointing. He needed the spirit. He needed the empowerment. And this is what I'm saying to you today. Your assignment is too significant for you to attempt it in your own strength. Your destiny is too great for you to pursue it with mere human ability. The calling on your life is too weighty for you to carry it with natural capacity. You need the Holy Spirit. You need the anointing. You need divine empowerment. And the good news is this. God is willing to give it to you. God is ready to fill you. God is prepared to anoint you. All you need to do is ask with a sincere heart, seek with genuine hunger, and receive with active faith. Now, I want to address something. Some people say, "Pastor, I have been baptized in the Holy Spirit. I spoke [music] in tongues many years ago. Why do I still need to be filled?" Listen to me carefully. The baptism of the Holy Spirit is your initial immersion into the realm of the spirit. It is your introduction into the supernatural dimension. It is your entry point into the world of spiritual power. But being filled with the spirit is a continuous experience. It is an ongoing relationship. It is a daily encounter. You can be baptized in the Holy Spirit and still not be walking in the fullness of the spirit. You can have the initial experience and still not be operating in the daily empowerment. This is why Paul prayed for the Ephesians in Ephesians 3:19 that they would be filled with all the fullness of God. This is why he prayed for the Colossians in Colossians 1:9 that they would be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding. You see, there are dimensions of the spirit that are progressive. There are depths of the spirit that are experiential. There are levels of the spirit that are developmental. And God wants to take you from glory to glory, from faith to faith, from strength to strength, from anointing to anointing. Let me tell you what happens when you are daily empowered by the Holy Spirit. Number one, your sensitivity to God increases. You begin to discern his voice more clearly. You begin to perceive his leading more accurately. You begin to recognize his warnings more quickly. The Bible says in Romans 8:14, "For as many as are led by the spirit of God, these are the sons of God." When the Holy Spirit empowers you, you become more attuned to divine direction. You become more responsive to heavenly guidance. You become more aligned with the will of God. Number two, your spiritual authority increases when the Holy Spirit empowers you. You don't just talk about demons, you cast them out. You don't just discuss sickness, you heal the sick. You don't just theorize about miracles, you perform miracles. You don't just read about faith, you walk in faith. You don't just study spiritual warfare, you engage in spiritual warfare and win. The Bible says in Luke 10:19, "Behold, I give you the authority to trample on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall by any means hurt you." This authority is activated by the empowerment of the Holy Spirit. Number three, your effectiveness in ministry increases. Whether you are a preacher, a teacher, an evangelist, a prophet, an apostle, a pastor, or a believer functioning in the marketplace, when the Holy Spirit empowers you, your impact multiplies, your influence expands, your fruitfulness enlarges. Jesus said in John 15:5, "I am the vine, you are the branches. He who abides in me and I in him bears much fruit. For without me, you can do nothing." The Holy Spirit is the one who connects us to the life of the vine. The Holy Spirit is the one who causes the sap of divine life to flow through us. The Holy Spirit is the one who produces the fruit. And somebody needs to hear this today. You have been struggling with baroness. You have been frustrated with lack of results. You have been discouraged by minimal impact. But the Lord is saying to you, it is not over. Your season of fruitfulness has come. [music] The Holy Spirit is about to empower you in a new dimension. What has been hard will become easy. What has been closed will open. What has been resistant will yield. What has been impossible will become possible. Get ready for a new level of effectiveness. Get ready for a new dimension of productivity. Get ready for a new season of supernatural results. Let me take you deeper into the scripture. In Acts chapter 2, when the Holy Spirit came on the day of Pentecost, the Bible says, "There appeared to them divided [music] tongues as of fire and one sat upon each of them." Now, fire is symbolic of several things in scripture. Fire represents purification. Fire represents illumination. Fire represents power. Fire represents passion. Fire represents presence. And all of these dimensions are part of the empowerment of the Holy Spirit. When the Holy Spirit empowers you with his fire, he purifies your motives. He burns away the draws. He refineses your character. He sanctifies your desires. You see, empowerment without character is dangerous. [music] Power without purity is destructive. Anointing without integrity is disastrous. This is why the Holy Spirit does not just empower you, he also transforms you. He does not just give you ability, he also develops your maturity. He does not just release gifts through you, he also produces [music] fruit in you. And this is very important for your assignment. God is not just interested in what you can do for him. He's interested in who you are becoming in him. God is not just focused on your productivity. He is focused on your character. God is not just concerned about your performance. He is concerned about your heart. And the Holy Spirit empowers you in such a way that your doing flows from your being. Your ministry flows from your intimacy. Your function flows from your fellowship. I decree over somebody today, the Holy Spirit will not just empower you for works. He will transform you into his image. He will not just use you as a vessel. He will make you a friend. He will not just flow through you. He [music] will dwell in you. You are being fashioned into a habitation of God through the spirit. You are being shaped into a temple of the Holy Ghost. You are being molded into a carrier of divine presence. Now, let me show you something very practical. When Jesus began his earthly ministry, the Bible says in Luke 3:20 1:22 that he was baptized and as he was praying, heaven was opened and the Holy Spirit descended upon him in bodily form like a dove. Now, this is significant. Jesus who is God in the flesh who is the second person of the trinity who is the creator of the universe even he needed the empowerment of the Holy Spirit before he began his ministry even Jesus did not operate in his [music] own strength even Jesus depended on the Holy Spirit even Jesus was anointed by the spirit and if Jesus who is perfect sinless divine needed the Holy Spirit how much more do we need the Holy Spirit if Jesus Jesus who is the son of God required empowerment. How much more do we require empowerment? If Jesus who is full of grace and truth needed anointing, how much more do we need anointing? This should humble us. This should create hunger in us. This should cause us to cry out for the Holy Spirit with greater desperation. You see, after Jesus was baptized in the Holy Spirit, the Bible says in Luke 4:1 that he was led by the spirit into the wilderness. In Luke 4:14, it says, "He returned in the power of the spirit to Galilee." In Luke 4:18, Jesus himself declared, "The spirit of the Lord is upon me because he has anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor. He has sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to set at liberty those who are [music] oppressed." You see, Jesus's entire ministry was conducted in the power of the Holy Spirit. Every miracle was by the spirit. Every healing was by the spirit. Every deliverance was by the spirit. Every word was by the spirit. And this is the pattern for us. We are called to follow in the footsteps of Jesus. We are called to do the works that he did and even greater works. But we can only do this in the same way he did it by the empowerment of the Holy Spirit. This is non-negotiable. This is fundamental. This is essential. I want to tell somebody, stop trying to do God's work in your own strength. Stop attempting to fulfill your calling with mere human ability. Stop struggling in the flesh when the spirit is available. The Holy Spirit is waiting to empower you. [music] The Holy Spirit is ready to equip you. The Holy Spirit is willing to anoint you. All you need to do is surrender. All you need to do is yield. All you need to do is depend. All you need to do is ask. Now before we go into prayer, I want to encourage you to share this word with someone. You see, we are living in days where many believers are struggling, many are discouraged, many are confused, many are defeated. Not because God has abandoned them, but because they are trying to live the Christian life without the empowerment of the Holy Spirit. They have zeal without power. They have desire without anointing. They have vision without enablement. And they need to hear this message. They need to understand that the Holy Spirit is available. They need to know that divine empowerment is accessible. They need to be reminded that God has not called us to powerless Christianity. So I encourage you, share this with your family. Share it with your friends. Share it with your colleagues. [music] Share it in your prayer groups. Share it on your social media platforms. Let this word go viral. Let this truth spread. Let this revelation reach those who are hungry because somebody's life is going to be transformed by this message. Somebody's ministry is going to be revived by this word. Somebody's faith is going to be ignited by this truth. And you will be a partaker of their blessing because you were the conduit through which the word reached them. Now let us pray. And as we pray, I want you to engage your spirit. I want you to activate your faith. I want you to open your heart. Don't just listen to me pray. Pray with me. Agree with me, contend with me. Because what is about to happen in this prayer is not just religious formality. This is spiritual transaction. This is divine impartation. This is heavenly empowerment. The Holy Spirit is about to fill you. The Holy Spirit is about to anoint you. The Holy Spirit is about to equip you for today's assignment. Holy Spirit, I welcome you into this atmosphere. I acknowledge your presence. I honor your person. I reverence your power. You are the third person of the blessed trinity. You are co-equal with the father and the son. You are God the holy spirit. And we invite you to have your way in this place. Come like a mighty rushing wind. Come like tongues of fire. Come like a gentle dove. Come in your fullness. Come in your glory. Come in your power. Father, in the name of Jesus, I lift up every person who is hearing this prayer. I thank you for their hunger. I thank you for their desperation. I thank you for their pursuit of you, Lord. They did not come here by accident. They are here by divine appointment. They are here because you have an agenda for their lives. They are here because you want to empower them. They are here because you want to equip them. They are here because you want to anoint them. And father, I pray right now in the name of Jesus that you will baptize them aresh in the Holy Ghost. [music] I pray that you will fill them to overflowing. I pray that you will saturate them with your presence. I pray that you will clothe them with power from on high. Let the rivers of living water flow from their innermost being. Let the oil of gladness rest upon them. Let the fire of [music] God consume every dross, every limitation, every hindrance, every obstacle that has prevented them from walking in the fullness of the spirit. Holy Spirit, I ask you to empower them for today's assignment. Whatever they are going to face today, whatever battles they are going to fight today, whatever decisions they are going to make today, whatever opportunities they are going to encounter today, I pray that you will give them wisdom, give them courage, give them strength, give them grace, give them favor, give them anointing, give them power. I speak to every spirit of fear, every spirit of doubt, every spirit of timidity, every spirit of confusion, every spirit of weakness. I command you to leave them now in the name of Jesus. You have no authority over the children of God. You have no legal right to operate in their lives. Be bound, be cast out, be rendered powerless in the mighty name of Jesus. And I release the spirit of power. I release the spirit of love. I release the spirit of a [music] sound mind. I release the spirit of wisdom. I release the spirit of understanding. I release the spirit of counsel. I release the spirit of might. I release the spirit of knowledge. I release the spirit of the fear of the Lord. I release the sevenfold spirit of God upon every person hearing this prayer. Father, I pray that their eyes will be enlightened. I pray that their ears will be opened. I pray that their hearts will be tender. I pray that their spirits will be quickened. I pray that their minds will be renewed. I pray that their bodies will be strengthened. I pray that their souls will be restored. I decree that they will walk in divine direction today. They will not miss their way. They will not make wrong decisions. They will not fall into temptation. They will not be overcome by the enemy. They will not be defeated by circumstances. They will walk in victory. They will walk in authority. They will walk in dominion. They will walk in power. Holy Spirit, I pray that you will speak to them clearly today. When they need guidance, guide them. When they need wisdom, grant them wisdom. When they need comfort, comfort them. When they need conviction, convict them. When they need encouragement, encourage them. When they need correction, correct them. When they need empowerment, [music] empower them. I pray for supernatural encounters today. I pray for divine appointments. I pray for strategic connections. I pray for open doors. I pray for uncommon favor. I [music] pray for breakthrough manifestations. I pray that today will be a day of testimonies. Today will be a day of victories. Today will be a day of transformation. Today will be a day of acceleration. Father, I speak over the assignments. Whether they in business, in education, in healthcare, in government, in ministry, in the marketplace, I pray that the Holy Spirit will empower them to excel. I pray that they will not be mediocre. I pray that they will not be average. I pray that they will be outstanding. I pray that they will be excellent. I pray that they will be exceptional. I pray that the spirit of God upon them will cause them to stand out, to rise above, to break limits, to shatter ceilings, to accomplish the impossible. I decree that sickness will not prosper [music] against them today. Accidents will not befall them today. Evil plots will not succeed against them today. Demonic manipulations will not work against them today. Witchcraft arrows will not locate them today because they are covered by the blood of Jesus. They are shielded by the power of the Holy Ghost. They are protected by the angels of the Lord. Holy Spirit, I pray that you will anoint their words today. When they speak, let heaven back them up. When they decree, let it be established. When they declare, let it manifest. When they prophesy, let it come to pass. Let their mouths be filled with wisdom. Let their tongues be instruments of blessing. Let their conversations be seasoned with grace. Let their communication be effective, powerful, [music] transformative. I pray for those who are going to difficult meetings today. I pray for those who are going to challenging negotiations today. I pray for those who are going to confrontational situations today. Holy Spirit, go before them, prepare the way. Soften hearts, open minds, remove obstacles, create favor, grant them the right words to say, give them the right attitude to carry. Position them for success. I pray for those who are facing financial challenges today. Holy Spirit, I ask you to open doors of provision. I ask you to release supernatural supply. I ask you to connect them to their helpers. I ask you to grant them creative ideas. I ask you to give them strategies for wealth creation. I ask you to bless the work of their hands. Let them prosper in the name of Jesus. I pray for those who are believing God for healing today. Holy Spirit, you are the same spirit that raised Jesus from the dead. I ask you to quicken their mortal bodies. I ask you to release healing virtue into every organ, every tissue, every cell. I command every sickness to leave. I command every disease to depart. I command every pain to go. I command every infirmity to bow, be healed in the name of Jesus. I pray for those who are struggling with addictions today. Holy Spirit, I ask you to break every chain. I ask you to destroy every yoke. I ask you to shatter every stronghold. I command the spirit of addiction to leave them now. I command the spirit of bondage to release them now. Let them be free. Let them walk in liberty. Let them experience the power of deliverance. I pray for those who are in leadership positions today. Holy Spirit, I ask you to grant them wisdom to lead well. I ask you to give them discernment to make right decisions. I ask you to empower them to influence positively. I ask you to anoint them to transform lives. Let them be leaders after God's own heart. Let them be shepherds who care for the flock. Let them be servants who advance the kingdom. I pray for families today. Holy Spirit, I ask you to bring peace to homes. I ask you to restore broken relationships. I ask you to heal wounded hearts. I ask you to reconcile separated couples. I ask you to protect children from evil. I ask you to guide parents in wisdom. Let families be havens of love, centers of peace, sources of strength. I pray for the youth today. Holy Spirit, I ask you to guard them from corruption. I ask you to deliver them from peer pressure. I ask you to preserve them in purity. I ask you to ignite them with passion for God. I ask you to empower them to stand for righteousness. Let them be a generation that will not compromise. Let them be a generation that will not bow to bal. Let them be a generation that will change the world. Father, I pray for those who are ministering the gospel today. I pray for preachers, teachers, evangelists, prophets, apostles, Holy Spirit. I ask you to anoint their lips. I ask you to sharpen their words. I ask you [music] to empower their messages. Let the word they preach be spirit and life. Let the truth they teach transform minds. Let the gospel they proclaim save souls. Back them up with signs following. Confirm their ministry with wonders. [music] establish their work with miracles. I decree that today demons will be cast out through [music] their ministry. Today the sick will be healed through their hands. Today the bound will be set free through their words. Today the lost will be [music] saved through their witness. Today the kingdom will advance through their obedience. Holy Spirit, I pray that you will position every person for greatness today. I pray that divine opportunities will find them. I pray that heavenly connections will locate them. I pray that supernatural favor will surround them. I pray that uncommon grace will rest upon them. Let this day be different from every other day. Let this day mark a turning point. Let this day be a day of distinction. I speak to every limitation, every restriction, every barrier, every wall be removed in the name of Jesus. I speak to every ceiling, every cap, every boundary, every border be broken in the name of Jesus. I speak to every cause, every hex, every spell, every enchantment be nullified in the name of Jesus. I speak to every agreement, every covenant, every vow, every [music] dedication be cancelled in the name of Jesus. And I release blessing. I release enlargement. I release expansion. I release multiplication. I release acceleration. I release elevation. I release promotion. I release advancement in the mighty name of Jesus. Holy Spirit, continue to fill them. Continue to empower [music] them. Continue to guide them. Continue to teach them. Continue to comfort them. Continue to strengthen them. Not just today, but every day. Not just this morning, but throughout this day. Not just in this moment, but in every moment. Let them walk in continuous fellowship with you. Let them live in constant awareness of your presence. Let them operate in perpetual dependence on your power. Father, I seal this prayer with the blood of Jesus. [music] I cover every person with the blood. I surround them with the blood. I mark them with the blood. Let the blood speak better things over their lives. Let the blood sanctify them. Let the blood protect them.
